import concurrent.futures, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time
folder=pathlib.Path('/work/home/resolved68-remaining'); folder.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
python=sys.executable
base=['node_modules/.bin/tsx','scientific/resolved-v68/campaign.ts','scientific/resolved-v68/specifications.json','/work/home/resolved68-campaign']
ids=['radial-r32-z64-g128-t256','axial-r64-z32-g128-t256','liner-r64-z64-g64-t256']
env=dict(os.environ,OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1')
def execute(label,command,timeout):
 started=time.monotonic()
 result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout,env=env)
 (folder/(label+'.log')).write_text(result.stdout+'\n'+result.stderr)
 record={'label':label,'command':command,'exitCode':result.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}
 (folder/(label+'.receipt.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
 return record
def reference():
 target=folder/'continuum';target.mkdir()
 scripts=pathlib.Path('scientific/current-v66')
 commands=[
 [python,str(scripts/'fixtures.py'),str(target/'cases.json')],
 ['node_modules/.bin/tsx',str(scripts/'campaign.ts'),str(target/'cases.json'),str(target/'production.json')],
 [python,str(scripts/'reference_fipy.py'),str(target/'cases.json'),str(target/'fipy.json')],
 [python,str(scripts/'analyze.py'),str(target/'cases.json'),str(target/'production.json'),str(target/'fipy.json'),str(target/'analysis.json')]]
 records=[]
 for i,command in enumerate(commands):
  row=execute('continuum-'+str(i),command,180);records.append(row)
  if row['exitCode']:break
 return {'label':'actual-fipy-continuum','commands':records,'exitCode':max(row['exitCode'] for row in records)}
records=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 jobs=[pool.submit(execute,value,base+[json.dumps([value])],850) for value in ids]
 jobs.append(pool.submit(reference))
 for job in concurrent.futures.as_completed(jobs):
  row=job.result();records.append(row)
  (folder/'receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if all(row['exitCode']==0 for row in records) else 1)
